row.evidence: Mailtrap's SSO guide says it "automatically creates users using just-in-time provisioning when a user logs in with Mailtrap SSO"; no SCIM endpoint appears in the docs index, API reference or pricing page.
row.notes: Unchanged status from June (none). Email API/SMTP pricing is flat by email volume, not per user (Basic from $15/mo with 3 users, Business from $85/mo with 100 users, Enterprise from $750/mo with unlimited users); monthly and annual prices shown identically. SSO change vs June: the pricing comparison table and the Pricing Plans doc put SAML SSO on Business for Email API/SMTP (Enterprise only for Email Sandbox, Pro for Email Marketing), while the SSO guide still says Enterprise only. Only automation is SAML JIT with SAML role mapping. Okta OIN app is SWA only; Entra/Google/OneLogin/JumpCloud are covered by Mailtrap's own custom-SAML guides, not catalogue apps. Audit log is Enterprise only, exposed via Audit Log webhooks (no audit-log REST API found).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: SSO per pricing table and Pricing Plans doc; the SSO guide says Enterprise only (see conflicts).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit log in the UI and as Audit Log webhooks; no audit-log REST endpoint found.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented; the docs index (llms.txt) has no SCIM page. Provisioning is SAML JIT only. false here means absent from all searched first-party pages, not an explicit vendor 'no'.

capabilities.notes: create_user false: users are created only by invite or SSO JIT; no create endpoint in the account-management reference. delete_user means removing the user's account access (permissions), not deleting the Mailtrap user.
